19541f0c6a7b72:
Linux permissions use octal notation:
  4 = read (r)
  2 = write (w)
  1 = execute (x)

Example: chmod 644 file  →  rw-r--r--
Example: chmod 755 file  →  rwxr-xr-x
Example: chmod 000 file  →  ----------

The file secreto.dat has permissions 000...
